ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups for other training crawlers (CCBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, etc.)
ideas.why: Config says trainingCrawlers: block but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the stated policy is mostly unenforced.

ideas.idea: Add explicit Allow groups for AI search crawlers
ideas.why: They are already allowed via the * group, so explicit groups add little beyond clarity.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD structured data (Bakery, Product, Course) to pages
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add concrete facts (bread names, prices, hours, class schedule, cost) to pages
ideas.why: Pages say 'over twenty loaves' and list two, and classes lack dates, prices and booking details, so concrete content helps readers and machines.
FAQs are not required and no FAQ is explicitly not a problem.

ideas.idea: Treat the content as too thin
ideas.why: Short pages are explicitly not a problem, though the specific missing facts are a separate valid point.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card tags
ideas.why: Accurate, but applies to nearly any site and has little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Fix the missing /img/loaves.jpg and add width/height
ideas.why: No img directory is in the provided files, but the image may exist in deployment, and width/height is a generic improvement.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the allergen notice
ideas.why: The data-nosnippet is a deliberate scoped choice.

ideas.idea: Add contact, address, phone and hours information and a contact/about page
ideas.why: No page gives location or contact details, which is a real gap for a local bakery.
Accurate, but lastmod is of minor value for a three-page site.

ideas.idea: Resolve /members/ being both disallowed and noindexed (use noindex alone)
ideas.why: The members page being noindex and disallowed is a deliberate, correct choice for a private page.

ideas.idea: Switch to extensionless clean URLs with redirects
ideas.why: Canonicals and sitemap are consistent, so this is cosmetic with little effect.
Having no llms.txt is not a problem, and it does not help with being found.

ideas.idea: Make the home page title and H1 more distinctive
ideas.why: The title and H1 already mention sourdough and York, so this is vague advice that applies to any site.
